import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 300010;
    static int P = 1000000009;
    static long[][] f = new long[19][N];
    static long[] ifac = new long[N], fac = new long[N], inv = new long[N];
    static int[] t = new int[20], g = new int[20];

    static long fpow(long a, int b, long c) {
        long res = c;
        long base = a % P;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = res * base % P;
            base = base * base % P;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init(int n) {
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P;
        }
        ifac[n] = fpow(fac[n], P - 2, 1);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            ifac[i] = ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % P;
        }
        inv[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            inv[i] = (long)(P - P / i) * inv[(int)(P % i)] % P;
        }
    }

    static void add(int[] x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            x[i] = (x[i] + y) % P;
        }
    }

    static void sub(int[] x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
            x[i] = (x[i] - y + P) % P;
        }
    }

    static int pop(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }

    static void fpow(long[] f, int n, int k) {
        int len = n;
        long[] tArr = new long[len];
        long[] gArr = new long[len];
        System.arraycopy(f, 0, tArr, 0, len);
        Arrays.fill(gArr, 0);
        f[0] = 1 - f[0];
        g[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            f[i] = 0;
            g[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                f[i] = (f[i] + f[i - j] * g[j]) % P;
                g[i] = (g[i] + tArr[i - j] * g[j]) % P;
            }
            sub(new int[]{(int)f[i]}, (int)g[i]);
            f[i] = (tArr[i] + f[i] * inv[i]) % P * k % P;
            g[i] = (tArr[i] - g[i] * inv[i]) % P * i % P;
            if (f[i] < 0) f[i] += P;
            if (g[i] < 0) g[i] += P;
        }
    }

    static void FMT(long[] f, int n) {
        for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += (l << 1)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                    f[i + j + l] = (f[i + j + l] + f[i + j]) % P;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void IFMT(long[] f, int n) {
        for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += (l << 1)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                    f[i + j + l] = (f[i + j + l] - f[i + j] + P) % P;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        P = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        long ans = fpow(k, n, 1);
        if ((n & 1) == 0) {
            int m = (int) (Math.log(n) / Math.log(2)) + 1;
            init(1 << m);
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << m); i++) {
                f[pop(i)][i] = ifac[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                long[] fArr = new long[1 << m];
                System.arraycopy(f[i], 0, fArr, 0, 1 << m);
                FMT(fArr, 1 << m);
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    long[] F = new long[1 << m];
                    System.arraycopy(f[j], 0, F, 0, 1 << m);
                    System.arraycopy(fArr, 0, F, 0, 1 << m);
                    f[j] = F;
                }
            }
            long[] F = new long[1 << m];
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    F[j] = f[j][i];
                }
                long[] Fpow = new long[1 << m];
                System.arraycopy(F, 0, Fpow, 0, 1 << m);
                fpow(Fpow, m + 1, k);
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    f[j][i] = Fpow[j];
                }
            }
            long[] fPopN = new long[1 << m];
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << m); i++) {
                fPopN[i] = f[pop(n)][i];
            }
            IFMT(fPopN, 1 << m);
            long temp = fPopN[n] * fac[n] % P;
            ans = (P + ans - temp) % P;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
